name: squish-memory
description: Local-first memory runtime for AI agents via MCP. Provides 18 tools for durable memory, recall, session search, and knowledge graph.

tools.name: squish_timeline
tools.description: 3-layer progressive disclosure for memory exploration (index, timeline, detail).

tools.name: squish_remember
tools.description: Store a new memory or learning. Auto-detects type and routes appropriately.

tools.name: squish_recall
tools.description: Recall memories by query, or retrieve a specific memory by ID.

tools.name: squish_forget
tools.description: Delete memory by ID or bulk delete with filters.

tools.name: squish_link
tools.description: Manage memory associations for graph-based reasoning.

tools.name: squish_context
tools.description: Get project context or list registered projects.

tools.name: squish_stats
tools.description: Get memory statistics for a project.

tools.name: squish_inspect
tools.description: Explain why a memory was retained, where it was routed, and whether raw fallback exists.

tools.name: squish_pin
tools.description: Pin or unpin a memory to prevent consolidation/pruning.

tools.name: squish_stale
tools.description: Show stale memories (old, low-confidence, or rarely accessed).

tools.name: squish_on_session_start
tools.description: Trigger session start - injects context from previous sessions, initializes session tracking.

tools.name: squish_on_tool_use
tools.description: Capture a tool use event for memory - stores observation about tool execution.

tools.name: squish_on_session_end
tools.description: Trigger session end - performs cleanup and signals session completion.

tools.name: squish_strategy
tools.description: Manage actionable strategies (read, write, list, search, supersede).

tools.name: squish_consolidate
tools.description: Run background consolidation - dedup, summarize, invalidate stale memories.
